name: BlitzFunnel – Funnel Builder, Landing Pages & Email Automation
author: Appestra

sections.description:
Build the funnel that fits your campaign

BlitzFunnel is a WordPress funnel builder for creating focused marketing funnels without requiring WooCommerce.

Instead of forcing every campaign into the same funnel structure, BlitzFunnel lets you decide how visitors move through your campaign.

Capture a lead first, send visitors directly to an offer, show a thank-you page, deliver a lead magnet by email, follow up with an email sequence, or combine these steps to match your campaign.

Flexible funnel paths

Your funnel does not have to follow one fixed sequence. Configure the steps you need for each campaign.

Common configurations include:

Capture, thank, nurture, and offer

Landing Page → Opt-In → Thank You Page → Email Sequence → Offer

Capture the visitor’s email address, show an optional thank-you page with an offer call-to-action or soft product pitch, and continue with an automated email sequence containing your offer link.

Direct offer with follow-up

Landing Page → Offer → Follow-Up Emails

Send visitors directly to an offer while using configured follow-up emails with offer links when your campaign needs continued communication.

Capture and send directly to the offer

Landing Page → Opt-In → Offer

Capture the lead and send the visitor directly to the offer after submission. You can use this path without an email follow-up sequence.

Direct offer

Landing Page → Offer

Send visitors directly from the landing page to an offer when lead capture is not needed for that campaign.

The funnel path is configurable, so you can choose the workflow that fits the campaign instead of adapting every campaign to a fixed funnel.

A simple way to think about BlitzFunnel

A funnel can use some or all of these building blocks:

Landing Page → Opt-In → Thank You Page → Email Sequence → Offer

You decide which steps your campaign needs.

For example:

Lead Magnet:
Landing Page → Opt-In → Thank You Page → Email With Attachment → Follow-Up Emails

Affiliate Campaign:
Landing Page → Opt-In → Offer → Follow-Up Emails With Offer Link

Direct Offer:
Landing Page → Offer

Short Lead Capture:
Landing Page → Opt-In → Offer

Landing pages

Create dedicated landing pages for your campaigns without changing the design of your main WordPress website.

BlitzFunnel funnel pages are designed to operate independently from your active WordPress theme. You can continue using your preferred theme or page builder for the rest of your website.

Use landing pages for:

  • Lead generation
  • Email list building
  • Lead magnets
  • Affiliate campaigns
  • Product presells
  • SaaS waitlists
  • Webinar registration
  • Coaching and consulting
  • Course launches
  • Product campaigns

Lead capture when you need it

Opt-in is configurable rather than mandatory for every funnel.

When your campaign needs lead capture, BlitzFunnel provides built-in opt-in forms that can be connected to the rest of your funnel.

Use an opt-in when you want to:

  • Build an email list
  • Deliver a lead magnet
  • Nurture prospects
  • Follow up after the initial visit
  • Introduce a product before sending visitors to an offer
  • Create a longer customer journey

If a campaign works better with a direct offer, you can configure the funnel without making visitors opt in first.

Thank-you pages with optional offers

A thank-you page can be used after an opt-in.

Depending on your campaign, the thank-you page can:

  • Confirm the submission
  • Continue the visitor journey
  • Present an optional offer call-to-action
  • Introduce a product with a soft pitch
  • Direct the visitor toward the next step

This gives you another opportunity to present an offer without making the initial landing page overly promotional.

Automated email follow-up

Create email sequences that continue the conversation after the funnel interaction.

Schedule follow-up messages by day and time and use them for:

  • Welcome emails
  • Lead magnet delivery
  • Lead nurturing
  • Product education
  • Affiliate campaigns
  • Offer reminders
  • Webinar follow-up
  • Course launches
  • SaaS waitlists
  • Consultation follow-up

Email sequences support plain-text and HTML messages, merge tags, and attachments.

Create and deliver lead magnets

BlitzFunnel can be used to create a simple lead magnet funnel without requiring a separate basic file-delivery workflow.

For example:

Landing Page → Opt-In → Thank You Page → Email With Lead Magnet

Attach a file such as a PDF guide, checklist, ebook, worksheet, or ZIP download directly to the email.

Attachments are stored in your WordPress media library.

Offer links

Send visitors to the destination that matters to your campaign.

Offer links can point to:

  • Affiliate offers
  • Product pages
  • External checkout pages
  • SaaS signup pages
  • Booking pages
  • Consultation pages
  • Course pages
  • Webinar registration pages
  • Other external destinations

Offer links can be used in landing page calls to action, thank-you page calls to action, and follow-up emails.

Affiliate marketing funnels

BlitzFunnel can be used to create affiliate marketing funnels in WordPress.

A campaign might look like:

Traffic → Landing Page → Opt-In → Thank You / Offer → Follow-Up Emails

Or, for a shorter campaign:

Traffic → Landing Page → Affiliate Offer

Use the funnel path that matches your promotion instead of forcing every affiliate campaign into the same sequence.

Lead generation funnels

Build a lead-generation workflow around the amount of information you need from a visitor.

For example:

Landing Page → Opt-In → Thank You → Nurture Emails

Or:

Landing Page → Opt-In → Offer

This makes BlitzFunnel useful for list building, lead magnets, product education, affiliate campaigns, and other campaigns where the visitor journey matters.

SaaS waitlists and pre-launch campaigns

Create a landing page for your upcoming product, collect interested visitors when appropriate, and configure a follow-up sequence to keep them informed.

A simple waitlist can use:

Landing Page → Opt-In → Thank You → Follow-Up Emails

Templates and niche copy

Starting from a blank page can make funnel building unnecessarily difficult.

BlitzFunnel includes starter landing page templates and pre-written niche copy to give you a practical starting point.

Available niche examples include:

  • Health
  • Finance
  • Beauty
  • SaaS
  • Make-money-online
  • Other marketing niches

Choose a starting point and customize the content, branding, images, forms, emails, and offer links for your campaign.

Guided funnel builder

The funnel setup wizard walks you through the main steps of creating a campaign.

Use the guided workflow to configure:

  • Your landing page
  • Opt-in behavior
  • Thank-you page
  • Offer destination
  • Email sequence
  • Email delivery
  • Funnel content

Live preview helps you see your funnel as you build it.

Email delivery

BlitzFunnel provides built-in email delivery options for automated follow-up sequences.

The plugin supports:

  • SMTP
  • PHP mail
  • Email queue
  • WordPress cron scheduling
  • Plain-text emails
  • HTML emails
  • Merge tags
  • Email attachments

Configure email delivery from:

BlitzFunnel → Settings → Email Delivery

For production email delivery, configure an SMTP server or supported email provider.

Spam protection without CAPTCHA

BlitzFunnel uses built-in honeypot protection and rate limiting to help reduce automated spam submissions.

Visitors do not need to solve CAPTCHA puzzles when submitting an opt-in form.

Lead management and WordPress privacy tools

Lead information is stored on your WordPress installation.

BlitzFunnel integrates with WordPress personal data export and erase tools for applicable lead records.

Site owners remain responsible for their privacy policy, consent practices, data retention, email practices, and other requirements applicable to their websites.

Funnel sign-up tracking

The free plugin provides sign-up counts for your funnels.

Use the dashboard to see how many sign-ups your funnels have captured.

Additional analytics and campaign tracking capabilities are available separately in BlitzFunnel Pro.

Who is BlitzFunnel for?

BlitzFunnel can be useful for:

  • Affiliate marketers
  • Bloggers and content creators
  • SaaS founders
  • Coaches and consultants
  • Course creators
  • Agencies
  • Small businesses
  • Product marketers
  • WordPress site owners building lead-generation campaigns

Free plugin features

The free plugin includes the core tools needed to create and run lead-generation funnels:

  • Guided funnel builder wizard
  • Unlimited funnels
  • Unlimited follow-up emails
  • Starter landing page templates
  • Email-capture landing templates
  • 20+ niche landing themes
  • Niche copy presets
  • Inline opt-in forms
  • Popup opt-in forms
  • Consent checkboxes
  • Configurable opt-in and direct-offer paths
  • Optional thank-you page with offer call-to-action
  • Automated email follow-up sequences
  • Day-based email scheduling
  • Time-based email scheduling
  • Plain-text emails
  • HTML emails
  • SMTP delivery
  • PHP mail delivery
  • Email queue
  • WordPress cron scheduling
  • Email attachments
  • Merge tags
  • Sign-up counts per funnel
  • Lead management
  • WordPress personal data export and erase tools
  • Honeypot spam protection
  • Rate limiting
  • Optional “powered by” footer credit
  • No WooCommerce requirement
  • No Appestra account required

BlitzFunnel Pro

BlitzFunnel Pro provides additional functionality for users who need more advanced funnel building, analytics, tracking, email, and automation capabilities.

Pro features include additional funnel types, analytics and campaign tracking, lead export, funnel duplication, advanced tracking, additional email delivery options, and other advanced capabilities.

The free plugin remains useful on its own and does not require an Appestra account.

Optional footer credit

BlitzFunnel does not require a footer credit on your funnel pages.

A small “powered by” credit can optionally be enabled under:

BlitzFunnel → Settings → Basics

The option is disabled by default.

Privacy and data

BlitzFunnel is designed so that your funnel and lead data remain on your WordPress installation.

The free plugin does not collect or transmit lead data or funnel content to Appestra.

Optional anonymous usage statistics are disabled by default and can be enabled by the site administrator.

When enabled, limited technical and usage information is sent to Appestra for product improvement.

No lead email addresses, lead records, funnel copy, or visitor data are included in these anonymous statistics.

Full privacy policy:

https://appestra.com/privacy/

Third-Party Libraries (source)

Admin UI bundles minified third-party libraries. Non-minified source is public:

  • Tom Select 2.4.1 (Apache-2.0) – https://github.com/orchidjs/tom-select
  • Tabler Icons 3.0.0 (MIT) – https://github.com/tabler/tabler-icons

License texts and file paths are also listed in THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.txt in the plugin.

External Services

This plugin may connect to external services only when you explicitly configure them or opt in to anonymous usage statistics under BlitzFunnel → Settings → Basics.

Appestra.com – Optional Usage Statistics (Opt-In Only)

  • When used: only if you enable “Share anonymous usage statistics” under BlitzFunnel → Settings → Basics. Off by default.
  • Data sent: site URL, blog ID, multisite flags, BlitzFunnel version, WordPress version, PHP version, locale, and funnel count. No lead emails, page copy, or visitor data is included.
  • Purpose: anonymous product improvement statistics.
  • Privacy policy: https://appestra.com/privacy/
  • Terms of service: https://appestra.com/terms-of-service/
  • Frequency: at most once per week while opted in.

Your SMTP server (Optional)

  • When used: only if you choose SMTP under BlitzFunnel → Settings → Email Delivery and enter your own mail server host, port, and credentials.
  • Data sent: outgoing follow-up emails, including the recipient address, subject, body, and attachments you configure, are transmitted to the SMTP host you specify.
  • Purpose: deliver automated follow-up emails from your WordPress site.
  • Terms / privacy: governed by your SMTP provider.

No other outbound requests are made by the plugin unless you configure email delivery or opt in to usage statistics.

Privacy

BlitzFunnel stores the following data on your WordPress site:

  • Funnel configuration, including titles, copy, offer URLs, and email sequences.
  • Lead records, including email address, name if provided, and consent timestamp.
  • Opt-in event data.
  • Plugin settings, including configured email provider credentials stored in the WordPress options table.

Lead data and funnel content are not transmitted to Appestra by the free plugin unless you opt in to anonymous usage statistics.

BlitzFunnel registers exporters and erasers under Tools → Export Personal Data and Tools → Erase Personal Data for applicable lead records matched by email address.

Support

Documentation:

https://appestra.com/docs/

Free plugin support:

https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/blitzfunnel/
sections.installation:
1. Install BlitzFunnel from Plugins → Add New in your WordPress dashboard, or upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/blitzfunnel.
  2. Activate BlitzFunnel through the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to BlitzFunnel → Create Funnel to launch the setup wizard.
  4. Choose the funnel path that matches your campaign.
  5. Configure your landing page, opt-in behavior, thank-you page, offer link, and email sequence as needed.
  6. Configure email delivery under BlitzFunnel → Settings → Email Delivery when using email follow-up.
  7. Publish your funnel and start your campaign.
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce to use BlitzFunnel?

No. BlitzFunnel does not require WooCommerce.

It is designed for lead-generation and offer funnels where the destination can be an affiliate offer, product page, external checkout, booking page, SaaS signup page, or another URL.

Does every funnel require an opt-in form?

No. Opt-in is configurable.

You can build a funnel that captures a lead before continuing, or configure a direct-offer path when lead capture is not needed for that campaign.

Can I send visitors directly to an offer from my landing page?

Yes. You can configure the landing page to send visitors directly to your offer.

Can I send visitors to an offer immediately after they opt in?

Yes. You can configure the funnel to send the visitor directly to the offer after the opt-in instead of showing a thank-you page.

Can I show a thank-you page after an opt-in?

Yes. A thank-you page can be used after an opt-in and can include an optional offer call-to-action and soft product pitch.

Can I use a thank-you page without making an offer?

Yes. The thank-you page can simply confirm the submission and continue the funnel without an offer call-to-action.

Can I use email follow-up with a direct offer?

Yes. You can configure follow-up emails with offer links when your campaign needs continued communication after the direct-offer path.

Can I choose not to send follow-up emails?

Yes. Email follow-up is configurable. A funnel can send visitors directly to an offer without requiring an email sequence.

Can I build a lead magnet funnel?

Yes. A common setup is:

Landing Page → Opt-In → Thank You → Email With Attachment

You can attach a PDF, checklist, ebook, worksheet, ZIP file, or another supported file to the email.

Do I need a separate lead magnet delivery plugin?

Not for a basic lead magnet delivered as an email attachment. BlitzFunnel can capture the lead and send the configured email with its attachment as part of the follow-up sequence.

Can I attach files to follow-up emails?

Yes. You can attach supported files such as PDF lead magnets or ZIP downloads to follow-up emails.

Attachments are stored in your WordPress media library.

Can I build an affiliate marketing funnel?

Yes. You can capture leads before an offer, send visitors directly to an affiliate offer, or use follow-up emails containing your offer link.

Can I build a SaaS waitlist?

Yes. A typical setup is:

Landing Page → Opt-In → Thank You → Follow-Up Emails

Can I use BlitzFunnel for coaching or consulting?

Yes. Capture prospects and direct them to your booking or consultation page, with or without a follow-up sequence depending on your campaign.

Can I use BlitzFunnel for webinars?

Yes. Create a registration funnel, capture leads when needed, and use follow-up emails for reminders or additional information.

Can I use BlitzFunnel for course launches?

Yes. Use a landing page to collect pre-launch interest and configure follow-up emails around your launch.

Is BlitzFunnel a general-purpose page builder?

No. BlitzFunnel is focused on dedicated funnel pages and the visitor journey around lead capture, follow-up, and offers.

You can continue using your preferred WordPress theme or page builder for the rest of your website.

Do I need a separate email marketing plugin?

No for the built-in follow-up workflow. BlitzFunnel provides email sequence creation and delivery options.

Can I use my own SMTP server?

Yes. Configure your SMTP host, port, username, and password under BlitzFunnel → Settings → Email Delivery.

Can I send HTML emails?

Yes. Follow-up email steps support plain-text and HTML messages.

Can I use merge tags in emails?

Yes. Email sequences support the available BlitzFunnel merge tags.

How many funnels can I create?

Unlimited. The free plugin supports unlimited funnels and follow-up emails.

What analytics are included in the free plugin?

The free plugin provides sign-up counts for your funnels.

Additional analytics and campaign tracking capabilities are available in BlitzFunnel Pro.

Can I export my leads?

CSV lead export is available in BlitzFunnel Pro.

The free plugin integrates with WordPress personal data export and erase tools for applicable individual lead requests.

Can I duplicate a funnel?

Funnel duplication is available in BlitzFunnel Pro.

The free plugin supports unlimited funnels, so you can create additional funnels whenever needed.

Does BlitzFunnel use CAPTCHA?

No. BlitzFunnel uses honeypot protection and rate limiting to help reduce automated spam submissions.

Does BlitzFunnel add a footer credit to my funnel pages?

No, not by default. You can optionally enable a small credit under BlitzFunnel → Settings → Basics.

Are my leads sent to Appestra?

No. Lead records and funnel content remain on your WordPress installation and are not sent to Appestra by the free plugin.

Optional anonymous usage statistics can be enabled separately by the site administrator.

Does BlitzFunnel help with privacy requests?

BlitzFunnel registers exporters and erasers under Tools → Export Personal Data and Tools → Erase Personal Data for applicable lead records.

Site owners remain responsible for their own privacy policy, consent practices, data retention, and legal compliance.

Does BlitzFunnel require an Appestra account?

No. The free plugin does not require an Appestra account.

Does BlitzFunnel require a credit card?

No. The free plugin can be used without entering payment information.

Is BlitzFunnel free?

Yes. The free plugin includes the core funnel-building functionality, including unlimited funnels, landing page templates, opt-in forms, automated follow-up emails, email attachments, and offer links.

Does BlitzFunnel have a Pro version?

Yes. BlitzFunnel Pro provides additional advanced funnel, analytics, tracking, email, and automation capabilities.

How do I report a security issue?

Please report security vulnerabilities through:

https://appestra.com/security/

Please do not publish security vulnerabilities in the public support forum.

What WordPress and PHP versions does BlitzFunnel support?

BlitzFunnel requires WordPress 6.2 or later and PHP 7.4 or later.

It is tested through WordPress 7.0.

WooCommerce is not required.

1.0.0

  • New: Initial release — funnel builder wizard, landing pages, opt-in forms, thank-you page, automated email sequences, direct offer links, and niche copy presets.
  • New: Unlimited funnels and follow-up emails.
  • New: Starter and email-capture landing templates.
  • New: Email delivery via SMTP or PHP mail with plain-text and HTML sequence steps.

  • Data sent: site URL, blog ID, multisite flags, BlitzFunnel version, WordPress version, PHP version, locale, and funnel count. No lead emails, page copy, or visitor data is included.
  • Purpose: anonymous product improvement statistics.
  • Privacy policy: https://appestra.com/privacy/
  • Terms of service: https://appestra.com/terms-of-service/
  • Frequency: at most once per week while opted in.

Your SMTP server (Optional)

  • When used: only if you choose SMTP under BlitzFunnel → Settings → Email Delivery and enter your own mail server host, port, and credentials.
  • Data sent: outgoing follow-up emails, including the recipient address, subject, body, and attachments you configure, are transmitted to the SMTP host you specify.
  • Purpose: deliver automated follow-up emails from your WordPress site.
  • Terms / privacy: governed by your SMTP provider.

No other outbound requests are made by the plugin unless you configure email delivery or opt in to usage statistics.

Privacy

BlitzFunnel stores the following data on your WordPress site:

  • Funnel configuration, including titles, copy, offer URLs, and email sequences.
  • Lead records, including email address, name if provided, and consent timestamp.
  • Opt-in event data.
  • Plugin settings, including configured email provider credentials stored in the WordPress options table.

Lead data and funnel content are not transmitted to Appestra by the free plugin unless you opt in to anonymous usage statistics.

BlitzFunnel registers exporters and erasers under Tools → Export Personal Data and Tools → Erase Personal Data for applicable lead records matched by email address.
